purpose: Every case of CoachingCore/r7/state-evidence/REGRESSION_R7ASE.json that differs from R7A-BOUNDARY-FINAL-FREEZE, with its cause. A case not named here fails the verifier's regression check.

R6-H17.operation: SEQUENCE (a missed key quality run in week index 4, a 5-day work trip in week index 5, return on Monday of week index 6)
R6-H17.whereItDiffers: Only the return's entry and the weeks it plans (step 2, REESTABLISH, weeks 6 and 7): easy runs 25 and 35 instead of 28 and 40 minutes, no strides yet, the quality run a threshold step of the familiar ladder (49 minutes) instead of the half-marathon-specific ladder (42 minutes), the long run 85 instead of 95 minutes, one set fewer on two accessories. R6-H17.cause: The case reports no execution for weeks 0-3: its first fact is in week index 4. The boundary freeze took the plan's projection of weeks 0-3 as executed, so its return started further along the progression.
R6-H17.direction: An earlier point of the same progression: fewer executed weeks counted. Loads, sets and run minutes are at or below the boundary freeze's, except the quality run, which is longer at a lower ladder step
